bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

bonuses.name: Bionik Boyz
bonuses.text: A number of ORK Threats equal to the Tier of the game that accompany Dok Bitzbak may have Bioniks (W&G page 246).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Dok Bitzbag may use Ruin actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Wetwork
abilities.text: Dok Bitzbak uses their Dok's Tools on an ally and makes an attack using one of its weapons, ignoring the Multi-Action DN penalty.

abilities.name: Dok's Tools
abilities.text: Dok Bitzbak makes a DN3 Medicae (Int) Test on an ally as a Simple Action. Every shifted Exhalted Icon causes the target to recover 1 additional Wound. If Dok Bitzbak rolls a Complication, the Test fails, and the target suffers an additional Wound
'Urty Syringe is printed without a Range: "8 +2 ED / Rending (6)".

abilities.name: Kwik Fix
abilities.text: Dok Bitzbak uses their Dok's Tools as a Simple Action.
